adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

prerequisites.description: Physical stamina for acrobatic martial steps
Knowledge of Ramayana and Mahabharata hymns

social_formats.description: Two competing parties in a ritual debate format

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular around a multi-tiered lit lamp (nilavilukku)

signature_moves.description: Acrobatic movements derived from traditional combat training
signature_moves.name: Martial art steps

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid breaking synchronization; avoid disrespecting the central lamp or the scholarly disputes.

music_profile.musical_form: Hymns from Ramayana, Mahabharata, and Bhagavata
music_profile.sound_description: A purely acoustic performance where the only sounds are the melodic chanting of Sanskrit and Malayalam hymns and the powerful, synchronized thudding of feet and clapping of hands.
music_profile.vocal_style: Call and response; leader (Panicker) sings and chorus repeats

basic_steps: Observe a month of abstinence and physical conditioning
Form a circle around the nilavilukku (lamp)
Execute synchronized hand clapping to establish the beat
Repeat the Panicker's melodic lines in chorus while moving
teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical stamina and knowledge of Hindu epics.

platform: Validated voice/movement feedback and accessible controls
